BlockLink.description: A link the home page shows: a route name (the browser holds the path) and its words.
BlockLink.title: BlockLink

Caption.description: A plain small line under a figure.
Caption.title: Caption

ChartPoint.description: One day: every level is a plain number or ``None`` (null) for a missing day.
ChartPoint.title: ChartPoint

CountFigure.description: A displayed count of option structures (a short put, a spread: one structure each).
CountFigure.title: CountFigure

EarningsCell.description: A results date: ``date`` is the ISO day, ``text`` what is shown (``10-28`` or ``已公布 10-20``).
EarningsCell.title: EarningsCell

HeldCompaniesSummary.description: Envelope (ADR 0034) and card. No envelope currency: the names carry their own.
HeldCompaniesSummary.title: HeldCompaniesSummary

IndexLevelFigure.description:
The level of a published market index in index points as its publisher states it (a Cboe
volatility index: 18.20 is 18.20 points). Not the 0 to 100 ease scale of ``IndexPointsFigure``:
the level has no upper bound in practice, the cap here only rejects a corrupt value.
IndexLevelFigure.title: IndexLevelFigure

IndexPointsFigure.description: A position on the stored 0 to 100 ease scale, or a change in it.
IndexPointsFigure.title: IndexPointsFigure

NeutralBand.description: The ends of the neutral band on the track, ``percent_of_track``.
NeutralBand.title: NeutralBand

PercentOfTrackFigure.description: A marker position on its track, 0 to 100.
PercentOfTrackFigure.title: PercentOfTrackFigure

SharePercentFigure.description: A share in whole percent, 0 to 100.
SharePercentFigure.title: SharePercentFigure

SourceTime.description: The data time of one source behind the card.
SourceTime.title: SourceTime

StaleLabel.description: Python sends the times and the label; the browser only compares its clock with ``stale_after``.
StaleLabel.title: StaleLabel

UsdFigure.description: A displayed US-dollar amount (two decimals in ``value``, whole dollars in ``text``).
UsdFigure.title: UsdFigure

UsdSignedFigure.description: A signed US-dollar amount; ``text`` starts with ``+`` or ``−`` (U+2212).
UsdSignedFigure.title: UsdSignedFigure

VolIndexItem.description:
One Cboe volatility index (VIX, VXN, RVX): its level in index points as Cboe publishes it
(18.20 is 18.20 points, not a fraction and not a percent), the data day ``mm-dd`` and the
source series. Never part of the IV cell of the index table: a Cboe index is a methodology of
its own.
VolIndexItem.title: VolIndexItem

VolatilityLine.description:
The tool's own HV30, IV30 and IV percentile of a name (ADR 0033 change 9). ``source`` is the short
label ("own"), ``label`` names the conventions and the data day; the figures are percents without a
sign or tone, a part that is not an ``ok`` reading of the day is a ``Gap``, and one of an earlier day
carries that day in its ``text``. ``reconciliation`` is the status the readings carry against IBKR's
series; no IBKR value is shown.
VolatilityLine.title: VolatilityLine

option_trader__viewmodels__common__Gap.description: A named data gap, used in place of a figure that cannot be computed. Never a zero.

option_trader__viewmodels__household_sum.title: Tiles

option_trader__viewmodels__options_summa.title: Gap

option_trader__viewmodels__options_summa.description: The four tiles, under fixed keys.
option_trader__viewmodels__options_summa.title: Tiles
